blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The full amount of Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth has yet to emerge as prosecutors continue to piece together evidence on properties, firearms and financial transactions against what she declared in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN), a House prosecutor said over the weekend. House prosecutor Terry L. Ridon of Bicol Saro Party-list declined to give an overall figure, citing the Senate impeachment court’s sub judice rule, but said prosecutors have already presented evidence involving assets worth millions of pesos. “Meron pong mga lote, ’yun pong mga baril.
